1.paper_title: [Sample] AI tutoring in grade 8 mathematics: a 12-week RCT
1.text: AI tutoring raised grade 8 math test scores by 25% after 12 weeks.

quotes.text: After 12 weeks, students using the AI tutor scored 25% higher on the end-of-unit mathematics test than the control group (p < 0.01).
The effect was consistent across the four participating schools.

2.paper_title: [Sample] A two-week classroom trial of an AI tutor
2.text: Two weeks of AI tutoring produced no significant test-score improvement.

quotes.text: After two weeks, test scores did not differ significantly between the tutor and control groups (p = 0.41).

3.paper_title: [Sample] Who benefits? AI tutors and prior achievement
3.text: AI tutoring gains were larger for students with lower prior achievement.

quotes.text: Gains from AI tutoring were roughly twice as large for students with below-median prior achievement.

1.label: apparent_contradiction
1.explanation: Both studies measured the same test in the same population, but A ran for 12 weeks and B for 2 weeks; B's authors note the short duration may explain the null result.

2.label: supports
2.explanation: C reports positive gains (larger for low achievers), compatible with A's positive overall effect, although C is abstract-only and quasi-experimental.
